paragraph: Diana Yousef was working at NASA on spaceborne sanitation when she started thinking about toilets for astronauts. The idea she came up with, the iThrone, works without water and does not need to be flushed. It is now installed in homes in Uganda, Panama, and the United States. Some twenty thousand households already have one. A machine built for the stars is keeping people safer here on the ground.
